tradery.info.vending_block: A shop in a block. Put a sample of the goods and a price in its settings, fill the stock, and players buy while you're away — for money or for items. With buyback it buys goods from players instead. Only you can break it.
tradery.info.display_block: A glass case that shows one item. Nothing is sold; the item inside is only a picture.
tradery.info.coin_ore: Found underground: copper at Y 0 to 96, silver at Y -32 to 32, gold at Y -64 to -16. Mining it puts the coins' value straight on your balance; machines and explosions drop coin items instead. Fortune doesn't help.
tradery.info.coin: Cash. Right-click to put coins on your balance (sneak: all of them); /tradery withdraw pays out coins. Pay with them in vending blocks that take items.

tradery.info.village_board: The way into a village's economy. Use it near a bell: deliver the village's orders for money from its treasury, see its level, treasury and your reputation, fund projects, check prices, market days and caravans. Crafted, and found on village market stalls (those only admins can break).

tradery.festival.title: Festival!

tradery.board.funded: You funded %s for %s. The village thanks you
tradery.board.prices_note: Villagers here pay these prices at your stalls; orders for dear goods pay more
tradery.board.licence_price: %s a day. You have no licence here
tradery.board.rent_tip: While the licence holds, this village's villagers come to your vending blocks nearby more often and from farther away. The money goes to the treasury
tradery.project.tradery.street_lamps.des: Street lights with lanterns hanging over the road stand along every dark street of the village: customers come to players' stalls 10% more often
tradery.project.tradery.granary.desc: A granary is built by the bell: the treasury holds 50% more; villagers' wallets hold one more day of wages
tradery.project.tradery.workshops.desc: A workshop with job sites is built by the bell: villagers earn 20% more a day, and so does the treasury
tradery.project.tradery.watch_post.desc: A watch post is built by the bell: an iron golem guards the village from now on; a lost raid costs half as much
tradery.project.tradery.market_stall.des: A market stall with server vending blocks is built near the bell, if there's a flat free spot (otherwise nothing is charged)
tradery.project.tradery.trading_yard.des: A trading yard is built by the bell: caravans set out a day sooner; market days come a day earlier
tradery.project.tradery.paved_streets.de: The streets around the bell are paved in stone and their dips filled; new buildings get a path to the street: customers come to players' stalls 5% more often
tradery.board.donation.desc: Money for the village's orders and projects. A fuller treasury posts bigger orders
tradery.board.donated: You gave %s to the treasury of %s. The village thanks you

tradery.info.market_counter: A market stall in a block: up to six offers, each with its own goods and money price, sold from one shared stock. Buyers pick an offer and buy ×1, ×8 or as many as they can. With "Villagers can buy" on, villagers come for the offer they need. Only you can break it.
tradery.info.shop_ledger: Lists your vending blocks and market counters wherever they are: what they sell, price, stock, item revenue waiting and what needs attention (sold out, no room, not set up). Shops far away show their last known state. "Show" puts a beam of light over one. Also /tradery shops.
